page: Microsoft Azure D8alds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine variant built on AMD EPYC 9V74 processors, operating at a 3.7 GHz clock speed with the x86_64 architecture. The instance provisions 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores using symmetric multithreading, backed by dedicated CPU allocation. Hardware cache includes 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB shared L3 cache. Vector processing and cryptographic workloads benefit from hardware-level instruction support, including AVX-512 extensions (F, VNNI, and BF16), alongside AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

System memory consists of 16.0 GB of RAM, equating to 2.0 GB per vCPU, which places this instance into Azure's reduced-memory compute tier. Local storage includes a bundled 472 GB NVMe solid-state drive, delivering direct high-speed IOPS for temporary volumes and caching. The instance operates without discrete GPU accelerators. In synthetic memory testing, large-block uncached read bandwidth measures 39.09 GB/sec, falling into the lower quartile, while cached small-block reads register 608.08 GB/sec and uncached writes reach 27.76 GB/sec.

CPU benchmark results indicate strong single-threaded performance, with Geekbench single-core reaching 2105.0 and stress-ng single-core achieving 3080.69, both ranking in the top 25 percent. Multithreaded execution aligns with midrange expectations, scoring 8199.0 in Geekbench multi-core and 12320.63 in stress-ng. Application throughput metrics show balanced behavior, achieving 11.55 million Redis SET operations per second and 11.85 GB/sec static web serving throughput, while prompt processing on 7B parameter language models reflects weak throughput at 23.53 tokens per second due to memory limitations.

With its 1:2 vCPU-to-memory profile and local NVMe storage, the D8alds_v6 offers favorable compute density for workloads that do not demand extensive RAM footprints. It is appropriate for CI/CD compilation pipelines, batch processing, static web tiers, and caching layers with local ephemeral persistence requirements.
description: Microsoft Azure D8alds_v6 is an x86_64 virtual machine featuring 8 vCPUs and 4 physical cores powered by a 3.7 GHz AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. Configured with a 1:2 memory ratio, the system includes 16.0 GB of RAM alongside a direct-attached 472 GB NVMe SSD for fast ephemeral storage. The processor supports modern vector instruction sets including AVX-512 and hardware cryptographic acceleration. In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates top-quartile single-thread performance in stress-ng and Geekbench tests, while multi-threaded capacity and application throughput remain midrange. Memory throughput for uncached large-block reads falls into the lower quartile, marking a bottleneck for memory-intensive data tasks. The server is well positioned for compile farms, web serving, microservices, and intermediate processing tasks needing dedicated CPU cycles and fast local disk access.
